name: Flannán mac Lugh
source:
Flannán mac Lugh, the newly crowned King of the Unseelie Court, is said to be the spitting image of his father, Lugaid—a traitorous, heretical madman to the Seelie, but a rebel hero and god among men to his people. No matter where your loyalties lie, though, there is a sense of apprehension in respect to Flannán's sudden ascension to the throne. After all, though Lugaid was venerated for his uprising against the hegemonic tyranny of the noble houses, the people of Tír na nÓg are weary of war. Alas, with the crowning of a younger King—known to be brash and temperamental, and tasked with upholding the legacy of his legendary father—some fear that the tentative peace between the Courts grows more fragile by the day.

With that said, Flannán is himself an elusive figure, with more than a few mysteries to his past. For one thing, following the war, it is said that he spent a great deal of time away from the Unseelie's new capital... but some suggest that it was not by his choice. Yet, if it is true that the young prince was once an exile, one must wonder why.

[From [url=https://moiraimyths.com/tgp]official website[/url]]
